name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A traditional Roman pasta dish made with crispy guanciale, egg yolks, Pecorino Romano, and freshly cracked black pepper.
instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Crisp the diced guanciale in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown.
Whisk together egg yolks, whole egg, grated Pecorino Romano, and black pepper in a bowl.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Combine hot pasta with guanciale, remove from heat, and quickly stir in egg mixture to create a creamy sauce, adding pasta water as needed.

name: Homemade Beef Wellington
description: Tender beef tenderloin coated with mushroom duxelles and prosciutto, wrapped in buttery, flaky puff pastry.
instruction: Sear beef tenderloin on high heat on all sides, then brush with English mustard.
Finely chop mushrooms and cook in a dry pan until all moisture evaporates to form a duxelles.
Lay out plastic wrap, arrange prosciutto, spread mushroom duxelles, and wrap tightly around the beef. Chill for 15 minutes.
Roll out puff pastry, wrap the beef log inside, brush with egg wash, and score top lightly.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and internal temp reaches 54°C (130°F).

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Rich Arborio rice slowly simmered in flavorful broth with sautéed cremini mushrooms, white wine, and Parmesan.
ingredients: 4 cups Vegetable or Chicken broth warm
instruction: Sauté mushrooms in olive oil until golden, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant, then toast Arborio rice for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with white wine and simmer until absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan cheese before serving hot.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Crispy sourdough toast topped with creamy mashed avocado, a perfectly runny poached egg, and chili flakes.
instruction: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado in a bowl with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Bring water to a gentle simmer with vinegar, swirl to create a whirlpool, and slide in eggs to poach for 3 minutes.
Spread avocado over toast, top with poached egg, and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
description: A fragrant, spicy Thai curry packed with tender chicken slices, bamboo shoots, Thai basil, and rich coconut milk.
ingredients: 400g Chicken breast cut into bite-size pieces
instruction: Heat 1/4 cup of coconut milk in a pot until oil separates, then stir-fry green curry paste until fragrant.
Add chicken slices and cook until no longer pink on the outside.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add bamboo shoots, eggplants, kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, and palm sugar; cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in fresh Thai basil leaves right before turning off the heat.

name: French Macarons
description: Delicate almond meringue sandwich cookies filled with smooth chocolate ganache.
instruction: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar together twice.
Whip egg whites while gradually adding granulated sugar until stiff, glossy peaks form.
Fold dry ingredients into meringue using the macaronage technique until batter falls in ribbon test.
Pipe rounds onto baking sheet lined with silicone mat, tap tray, and rest 30-45 minutes until skin forms.
Bake at 150°C (300°F) for 15 minutes, cool completely, and sandwich with dark chocolate ganache.

name: Greek Salad with Feta
description: Crisp cucumbers, ripe tomatoes, red onions, Kalamata olives, and a thick block of Greek feta cheese.
instruction: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and Kalamata olives in a salad bowl.
Drizzle extra virgin olive oil and red wine vinegar over the vegetables.
Place a slice of feta cheese on top of the salad.
Sprinkle generously with dried oregano and serve chilled.

name: Japanese Tonkotsu Ramen
description: Deeply flavorful pork bone broth served with springy ramen noodles, tender chashu pork, and soft-boiled marinated egg.
instruction: Boil pork bones vigorously for 8-12 hours until broth turns milky white and emulsified.
Prepare tare season sauce and place 2 tbsp in the bottom of serving bowls.
Boil ramen noodles for 1-2 minutes until al dente.
Pour hot tonkotsu broth into bowls with tare, add strained noodles.
Top with chashu pork slices, halved soft-boiled eggs, green onions, and nori.

name: Classic Caesar Salad with Grilled Chicken
description: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in homemade Caesar dressing, topped with parmesan shavings, garlic croutons, and grilled chicken breast.
instruction: Whisk mayonnaise, anchovy paste, garlic, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard for the dressing.
Grill chicken breasts on medium-high heat until internal temp reaches 74°C (165°F), then slice.
Toss chopped romaine lettuce with dressing in a large bowl.
Top with grilled chicken slices, croutons, and shaved parmesan cheese.

name: Vietnamese Beef Pho
description: A comforting Vietnamese noodle soup featuring aromatic beef bone broth simmered with cinnamon, star anise, and fresh herbs.
ingredients: Fresh Thai basil, cilantro, bean sprouts, lime wedges
instruction: Parboil bones for 10 minutes, rinse clean, then simmer with charred onion, ginger, and toasted spices for 4-6 hours.
Season broth with fish sauce and rock sugar.
Cook flat rice noodles and divide into bowls.
Lay raw sirloin slices over hot noodles, pour scalding broth over to cook beef instantly.
Serve with fresh bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, and lime wedges.

name: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Simple Neapolitan-style pizza topped with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, and sweet basil leaves.
instruction: Preheat oven with pizza stone to maximum temperature (250°C/500°F or higher).
Stretch dough manually into a 12-inch round on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce lightly over dough, leaving a border for crust.
Distribute fresh mozzarella pieces across sauce.
Bake for 8-12 minutes until crust is blistered, top with fresh basil and olive oil.

name: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
description: Decadent, rich chocolate brownies with crinkly tops and gooey fudgy centers.
instruction: Melt butter and dark chocolate together until smooth.
Whisk eggs and sugar vigorously for 2 minutes until pale and frothy.
Fold melted chocolate mixture into egg mixture.
Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and salt; gently fold until just combined.
Pour into lined 8x8 inch pan and bake at 175°C (350°F) for 22-25 minutes.

name: Spanish Seafood Paella
description: Traditional Spanish rice dish loaded with saffron, shrimp, mussels, squid, and bell peppers.
ingredients: 1 pinch Saffron threads soaked in 1/4 cup warm water
instruction: Sauté shrimp and squid in olive oil in paella pan, then remove and set aside.
Cook red pepper and grated tomato in same pan to form sofrito.
Add Bomba rice, stir to coat in oil, then pour in seafood stock and saffron liquid.
Simmer uncovered without stirring for 18 minutes until rice absorbs liquid and bottom forms crust (socarrat).
Nestle seafood on top during last 5 minutes of cooking.

name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets coated in a savory-sweet honey, soy sauce, and garlic glaze.
ingredients: Lemon slices and parsley for garnish
instruction: Whisk honey, soy sauce, lemon juice, and garlic in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in pan over medium-high heat and sear salmon skin-side up for 3 minutes.
Flip salmon fillets and pour sauce into pan.
Baste salmon continuously with glaze as sauce reduces for another 3 minutes until thick.

name: Mexican Birria Tacos
description: Crispy corn tortillas dipped in chili oil, filled with tender shredded beef and melted cheese, served with consommé broth.
instruction: Rehydrate dried chilies in hot water, then blend with garlic, vinegar, and spices to make sauce.
Braise beef in chili sauce and broth for 3-4 hours until shreddable; separate meat and reserve broth (consommé).
Dip corn tortillas in red oil from broth, lay on hot skillet.
Top with cheese and shredded beef, fold tacos, and fry until crisp.
Serve warm dipped in consommé broth with cilantro and onions.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
description: Smooth, comforting soup made from roasted tomatoes, garlic, heavy cream, and fresh basil.
instruction: Roast halved tomatoes and head of garlic drizzled with olive oil at 200°C (400°F) for 40 minutes.
Sauté onions in a pot until translucent.
Squeeze roasted garlic out of peel and add roasted tomatoes to pot with vegetable stock.
Blend mixture until completely smooth using an immersion blender.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh basil, season to taste, and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Indian Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Marinated grilled chicken pieces cooked in a rich, spiced, creamy tomato curry sauce.
instruction: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the spices, garlic, and ginger for at least 30 minutes.
Sear marinated chicken in a pan until browned and set aside.
Sauté onions in same pan, add remaining spices, tomato puree, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Puree sauce until smooth, add heavy cream and cooked chicken.
Simmer for 15 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Flaky, buttery, laminated French pastry with light honeycomb interior structure.
instruction: Mix dough ingredients, knead briefly, and chill overnight.
Encase cold butter block inside dough envelope and perform 3 single envelope folds with chilling between folds.
Roll out laminated dough thin, cut into long triangles, and roll into crescent shapes.
Proof croissants at 24°C (75°F) for 2.5 hours until puffy and jiggly.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 18-20 minutes.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowl
description: Juicy pan-seared chicken glazed with homemade sweet teriyaki sauce, served over steamed rice and broccoli.
instruction: Combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a cup to make teriyaki sauce.
Pan-fry chicken thighs skin-side down until crispy, then flip.
Pour teriyaki sauce into pan and simmer until reduced to a shiny syrup coating chicken.
Slice chicken and serve over steamed rice with broccoli, garnished with sesame seeds.

name: Portuguese Egg Tarts (Pastéis de Nata)
description: Crispy puff pastry shells filled with rich, caramelized egg custard.
ingredients: 1 Puff pastry sheet rolled into log
instruction: Boil sugar and water with cinnamon stick and lemon peel to make simple syrup.
Whisk flour into cold milk, cook until thick, then whisk in hot syrup and egg yolks.
Slice puff pastry log into discs and press into muffin tins to form shell doughs.
Pour strained custard into pastry shells.
Bake at highest oven temp (260°C/500°F) for 12-15 minutes until pastry is crisp and custard top chars.

name: Crispy Korean Fried Chicken
description: Extra crunchy double-fried chicken wings tossed in a sweet, spicy, and sticky Gochujang glaze.
instruction: Coat chicken wings evenly with potato starch and flour blend.
Fry wings at 170°C (340°F) for 10 minutes, remove and drain.
Double fry at 190°C (375°F) for 3-5 minutes until golden brown and super crunchy.
Simmer Gochujang, honey, sugar, and soy sauce in skillet to thicken glaze.
Toss fried wings in sauce until fully coated.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Rich beef broth packed with caramelized onions, topped with a toasted baguette slice and melted Gruyère cheese.
instruction: Caramelize onions slowly in butter over low heat for 45-60 minutes until deep brown.
Deglaze pot with white wine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add beef stock and fresh thyme; simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top with baguette slice and generous Gruyère.
Broil in oven for 3-5 minutes until cheese bubbles and browns.

name: Classic Belgian Waffles
description: Fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside light waffle recipe served with maple syrup and berries.
ingredients: 2 Egg whites whipped to stiff peaks
instruction: Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a large bowl.
Mix milk, butter, egg yolks, and vanilla extract in a separate container.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
Gently fold in whipped egg whites.
Pour into hot waffle iron and cook until golden brown and crisp.

name: Classic Beef Smash Burgers
description: Thin, crispy-edged beef patties pressed on a piping hot flat top with American cheese in a brioche bun.
instruction: Divide ground beef into two loose balls.
Place ball on screaming hot cast-iron skillet and smash completely flat with heavy spatula.
Season with salt and pepper; cook for 2 minutes until edges char.
Flip, immediately add cheese slice, and cook for another 1 minute.
Stack double patties inside toasted brioche bun spread with burger sauce and pickles.

name: Matcha Green Tea Latte
description: Smooth, earthy Japanese ceremonial grade matcha whisked with warm micro-foamed milk.
instruction: Sift matcha powder into a wide bowl to eliminate clumps.
Pour hot water over matcha and whisk in a 'W' motion using a bamboo whisk until frothy.
Heat and foam milk until silky.
Pour sweet syrup into a glass, add whisked matcha, and top with steamed warm milk.

name: Greek Lamb Souvlaki
description: Tender marinated lamb cubes grilled on skewers served with pita bread and cool tzatziki sauce.
instruction: Marinate lamb cubes with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano for 2 hours.
Thread marinated lamb onto wooden skewers.
Grill on high heat for 8-10 minutes, turning regularly until nicely charred.
Serve hot inside warm pita bread topped with homemade tzatziki sauce.

name: Classic Tiramisu
description: Traditional Italian dessert of espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with rich mascarpone cream and cocoa powder.
instruction: Whip egg yolks and sugar until thick, then fold in softened mascarpone cheese.
Mix cooled espresso with dark rum.
Quickly dip ladyfingers into espresso mixture and lay in bottom of dish.
Spread half of mascarpone cream over ladyfingers.
Repeat second layer of ladyfingers and cream, dust generously with cocoa powder, and chill for 6 hours.

name: Fresh Vietnamese Spring Rolls
description: Refreshing rice paper rolls packed with cooked shrimp, pork, rice vermicelli, and crisp raw herbs.
instruction: Dip rice paper wrapper into warm water for 5 seconds until pliable.
Lay wrapper flat, add lettuce, cooked rice vermicelli, mint, and cilantro.
Place halved shrimp pink-side down near upper edge.
Fold sides in and roll tightly from bottom up.
Serve fresh with creamy peanut dipping sauce.

name: Chicken and Waffles
description: Crispy fried chicken placed over thick warm waffles, drizzled generously with spicy maple syrup.
instruction: Prepare crisply fried seasoned chicken tenders.
Bake thick waffle batter until crisp.
Warm maple syrup mixed with hot sauce and melted butter in saucepan.
Plate crispy fried chicken on top of waffles, dust with powdered sugar, and drizzle with spicy maple syrup.

name: Classic Beef Chili
description: Hearty ground beef chili simmered with kidney beans, crushed tomatoes, and warm aromatic spices.
instruction: Brown ground beef and diced onion in heavy pot; drain excess fat.
Stir in chili powder and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth.
Simmer covered on low heat for 45 minutes.
Serve hot topped with shredded cheddar cheese and sour cream.

name: Classic Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy fried chickpea balls served inside warm flatbread with tahini, tomatoes, and pickled turnip.
instruction: Pulse chickpeas, parsley, garlic, cumin, flour, salt, and pepper in food processor into coarse mixture.
Form mixture into small balls.
Deep fry falafels in hot oil at 180°C (350°F) for 4 minutes until dark golden brown.
Assemble inside pita flatbread with veggies and drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Japanese Pork Katsudon
description: Crispy panko-breaded pork cutlet cooked with egg and onions in a sweet dashi broth over rice.
instruction: Bread pork chops with flour, egg, and panko; deep fry until crispy tonkatsu.
Simmer sliced onion in dashi stock, soy sauce, and mirin in a small skillet.
Slice tonkatsu and place into skillet over onions.
Pour beaten eggs around pork, cover for 1 minute until eggs are soft set.
Slide entire mixture over a bowl of hot steamed rice.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Scampi
description: Succulent shrimp sautéed in rich garlic butter, white wine, and lemon juice tossed with linguine.
instruction: Boil linguine in salted water until al dente.
Melt butter in pan over medium heat, add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and white wine; cook for 2 minutes per side until pink.
Stir in lemon juice and cooked linguine.
Toss to coat thoroughly and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

name: Classic Cheesecake
description: Rich, creamy New York style baked cheesecake on a graham cracker crust.
instruction: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter, press into springform pan, and bake for 10 minutes.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then mix in sour cream and vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time on low speed.
Pour filling over crust and bake in water bath at 160°C (325°F) for 60-70 minutes.
Cool completely inside turned-off oven then chill 8 hours.

name: Pad Thai with Shrimp
description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, crushed peanuts, bean sprouts, and tangy tamarind sauce.
ingredients: Bean sprouts, garlic chives, crushed peanuts
instruction: Whisk tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar together for sauce.
Sauté shrimp and tofu in hot wok, push to side, scramble eggs in wok.
Add soaked noodles and tamarind sauce; toss vigorously over high heat until noodles absorb liquid.
Stir in bean sprouts and garlic chives.
Serve hot sprinkled with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: French Beef Bourguignon
description: Rich French beef stew braised in red wine with bacon lardons, pearl onions, and mushrooms.
instruction: Crisp bacon lardons in Dutch oven, then sear beef cubes in bacon fat until browned.
Stir in tomato paste, red wine, beef stock, thyme, and bay leaves.
Cover and braise in oven at 160°C (325°F) for 2.5 hours.
Sauté pearl onions and mushrooms in butter separately.
Stir vegetables into stew and simmer 15 additional minutes until beef is fork-tender.

name: Greek Gyros Wrap
description: Seasoned sliced pork gyro stuffed inside soft pita bread with tzatziki, tomato, onion, and French fries.
instruction: Marinate pork slices with oregano, vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Sear pork in hot skillet until browned and slightly charred at edges.
Warm pita bread flatbreads.
Spread tzatziki on pita, fill with cooked pork, tomato, red onion, and crispy fries.
Wrap tightly in parchment paper.

name: Classic Lemon Tart
description: Crispy shortcrust pastry shell filled with zesty, silky smooth lemon curd.
instruction: Whisk eggs, sugar, lemon juice, and zest in heatproof bowl over simmering water pot.
Cook continuously for 10-12 minutes until curd thickens.
Remove from heat and whisk in butter pieces one by one until smooth.
Pour lemon curd into pre-baked pastry shell.
Bake at 160°C (320°F) for 5 minutes to set curd, then chill 4 hours.

name: Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
description: Al dente penne pasta tossed in vibrant homemade basil pesto with sweet roasted cherry tomatoes.
instruction: Boil penne pasta until al dente.
Blend fresh basil, toasted pine nuts, garlic, parmesan, and olive oil in processor until smooth pesto forms.
Sauté cherry tomatoes in pan with olive oil for 2 minutes until blistered.
Toss hot drained pasta with pesto sauce and blistered cherry tomatoes.

name: Classic Buffalo Chicken Wings
description: Crispy baked chicken wings tossed in a spicy, buttery Cayenne pepper hot sauce.
instruction: Toss wings with baking powder and salt; arrange on wire rack over baking sheet.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 45 minutes, flipping halfway until super crispy.
Whisk hot sauce and melted butter in bowl.
Toss crispy hot wings in buffalo sauce and serve immediately with celery and blue cheese dip.

name: Japanese Chicken Katsudon Curry
description: Crispy panko-breaded chicken cutlet served over rice with rich Japanese curry sauce.
instruction: Boil onions, carrots, and potatoes in water for 15 minutes until tender.
Turn off heat, stir in curry roux blocks until dissolved, then simmer 5 minutes to thicken.
Fry breaded chicken cutlet until golden and slice.
Serve sliced cutlet next to steamed rice and ladle curry sauce over top.

name: Classic Beef Lasagna
description: Layered pasta bake with rich beef ragù sauce, creamy béchamel, and melted mozzarella cheese.
instruction: Simmer ground beef and crushed tomatoes for 40 minutes to make meat sauce.
Spread thin layer of meat sauce in 9x13 baking dish.
Layer lasagna noodles, meat sauce, béchamel sauce, and mozzarella cheese.
Repeat layers 3 times, ending with mozzarella and parmesan on top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 45 minutes until top is bubbly and brown.

name: Acai Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended frozen acai berry bowl topped with fresh banana slices, berries, chia seeds, and granola.
instruction: Blend frozen acai packet, frozen banana, frozen blueberries, and splash of almond milk until thick and smooth.
Scoop thick smoothie into a bowl.
Arrange fresh strawberries, banana slices, granola, and chia seeds neatly on top.

name: Beef Gyudon Bowl
description: Thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a sweet soy dashi sauce served over hot rice.
instruction: Bring dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to a boil in pan.
Add sliced onions and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add thin beef slices and cook for 2 minutes until beef changes color.
Ladle beef and sweet onion broth over bowls of warm steamed rice.

name: Classic French Crepes
description: Paper-thin sweet French pancakes filled with Nutella and fresh banana slices.
instruction: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, and sugar until completely smooth batter; rest for 15 minutes.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into hot buttered non-stick skillet, swirling to cover bottom thinly.
Cook for 1 minute, flip, and cook 30 seconds.
Spread Nutella over crepe, add banana slices, and fold into triangles.

name: Classic Shepherd's Pie
description: Savory minced lamb and vegetable filling topped with a golden, toasted mashed potato crust.
instruction: Sauté ground lamb and onion until browned; drain fat.
Stir in tomato paste, peas, carrots, and beef broth; simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Transfer meat mixture into baking dish.
Spread creamy mashed potatoes evenly over meat and pipe edges; sprinkle cheese.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until potato peak edges brown crisp.

name: Crispy Pork Carnitas Tacos
description: Slow-cooked Mexican braised pork finished in high-heat skillet for crisp edges, served in corn tortillas.
instruction: Combine pork, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt in Dutch oven.
Cover and slow cook at 150°C (300°F) for 3.5 hours until pork falls apart.
Shred pork, spread on baking sheet, and broil high for 5-8 minutes until edges crisp.
Serve crispy carnitas inside warm corn tortillas with onion and cilantro.

name: Italian Caprese Salad
description: Simple summer salad of fresh thick mozzarella slices, ripe tomatoes, and sweet basil drizzled with balsamic glaze.
ingredients: Flaky sea salt and black pepper
instruction: Alternate slices of fresh tomato and fresh mozzarella on a serving platter.
Tuck fresh whole basil leaves between the tomato and cheese slices.
Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with flaky sea salt and cracked black pepper.

name: Classic Eggs Benedict
description: Toasted English muffin halves topped with Canadian bacon, poached eggs, and warm Hollandaise sauce.
instruction: Whisk 3 egg yolks and lemon juice over simmering water pot until doubled in volume.
Slowly drizzle in melted butter while whisking vigorously to emulsify hollandaise sauce.
Poach 4 eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes.
Sear Canadian bacon in pan.
Top toasted muffin halves with bacon, poached egg, and cover with warm hollandaise sauce.

name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
description: Warm spiced marinated chicken slices served with yellow rice, garlic toum sauce, and pickled vegetables.
instruction: Marinate chicken thighs with olive oil, lemon juice, and spices for 1 hour.
Sear chicken in hot pan until charred and fully cooked.
Slice chicken into thin ribbons.
Plate sliced shawarma chicken next to yellow turmeric rice.
Serve with garlic toum dip and pickled turnip cucumbers.
